name: test-ai-marketplace
description: Personal Claude Code plugin marketplace: engineering skills and agents for spec-driven development

plugins.name: architecture-review
plugins.description: Read-only architecture reviewer agent: audits a module, a package or a branch diff against onion-architecture and frontend-architecture rules and returns findings with evidence as JSON

plugins.name: engineering-paved-path
plugins.description: Engineering knowledge skills for TypeScript web projects: Fastify, React, Next.js, React Testing Library, onion architecture, frontend architecture and security rules

plugins.name: research-tools
plugins.description: Read-only researcher agent that answers one concrete question from a repository or from external sources and returns an evidence-backed report

plugins.name: sdd-engineering
plugins.description: Spec Driven Development: spec, options, plan, implementation and verification, with a run-plan entry point and a workflow retro. Installs engineering-paved-path, research-tools and architecture-review as dependencies
